strips.title: A day in Lisbon with the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2

panels.head: The menu is in Portuguese
panels.text: "Hey Meta, read this." You hear it in English. Nobody reaches for a phone.

panels.head: Hands-free photos, 3K video
panels.text: Tap the temple. 12MP shots and 3K video from your own point of view.

panels.head: Grandma joins the walk
panels.text: A WhatsApp video call streams what you see. Both hands stay free.

panels.head: Hotel gym: glasses off
panels.text: Cameras aren't welcome everywhere. The case adds 48 hours of charge while you train.
